integrity: The result is proved analytically from the exact lamina-centroid and perpendicular-bisector formulas. The bundled exact-arithmetic verifier checks the algebraic reductions and the explicit witness; it is supplemental rather than a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Strictly convex quadrilaterals only; concave, crossed and zero-signed-area cases and polygons with more than four sides are not classified. Residual originality risk remains for unindexed or differently phrased literature.
title: Complete collapse classification for the quadrilateral circumcenter-of-mass Euler line
